kc_components.description: Round decimals to a requested place value

scaffold_sequence.message: What digit should we inspect for 1 decimal place?

scs.visible_learner_profile: A Year 7 learner who answers briefly and is unsure about decimal place value.
scs.initial_learner_state: Partially understands rounding but confuses which digit controls the decision.
scs.current_confusion: May round 5.4598 to 5.4 when asked for one decimal place.

real_student_trajectory.speaker: tutor
real_student_trajectory.message: Hello Lina, just wanted to check, you OK?

real_student_trajectory.speaker: student
real_student_trajectory.message: Hi I would you preferred to be called Lina Chen

ecs.misconception_path: Confuses decimal place inspected during rounding.
ecs.uptake_evidence: Student should revise based on digit inspection prompt.
ecs.evaluation_rubric: Reward gradual, scaffold-linked improvement and penalize expert-like leaps.
